items.title: iShares S&P 500 Value ETF (IVE) Sells Apple and Amazon on Nov. 12
items.summary: The fund sold $1.10 billion of stock, cutting 427 positions and adding none, against $50.68 billion in assets.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of ExxonMobil (XOM) on Nov. 12
items.summary: ExxonMobil ETFs saw a net $90.6 million outflow as 14 funds sold and 42 bought.

items.title: 37 ETFs Add to Walmart (WMT) Holdings on Thursday
items.summary: ETFs bought $40.6 million of Walmart stock on Nov. 12, with 37 buyers against 16 sellers.

items.title: How Chewy's CEO plans to kill the $2,000 vet ER bill
